_published_faq.name: How do I add Turo to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Turo to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.turo.com/v1/mcp.

acceptedAnswer.text: Turo provides these MCP tools: search_vehicles.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Turo?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Turo in travel on the Manufact MCP catalog include ChargeHub, Inbin Pulse, PLAZA Hotels, Point Hacks, and Skimetric.
